sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a red car moving on a straight road and a
pedestrian on the sidewalk; student toggles the référentiel (road /
car / pedestrian) via a picker. Trajectory of the same point (a fly
on the car roof) redraws as a horizontal line, a stationary dot, or
an inclined line depending on reference frame chosen. Advance after
all 3 frames viewed. Experiment: 3 seeded (frame, expected trajectory)
quiz pairings — student picks the correct frame. Evaluate: only the
dot's motion visible in one frame; student names the frame it appears
stationary in. Wrinkle: 1ère depth — no vectors, purely qualitative.
